select clazz.*, emp.name as masterName, case when now() > clazz.end_date then '已结课' when now() < clazz.begin_date then '未开班' else '在读中' end as status from clazz left join emp on clazz.master_id = emp.id
and clazz.name like CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
and clazz.end_date between #{begin} and #{end}
order by clazz.update_time desc
select clazz.name as name, count(student.clazz_id) as value from clazz left join student on clazz.id = student.clazz_id group by clazz.id, clazz.name order by clazz.id
